Report Description/// UPDATE TO NRC REPORT #1443307 /// UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER STATES THAT ONE RAILCAR TIPPED WHILE RE-RAILING, THIS CAUSED A RELEASE OF DENATURED FUEL ETHANOL ONTO THE GROUND, THE AMOUNT RELEASED IS 1500 GALLONS. THE RELEASE WAS SECURED, CLEAN UP IS STILL ONGOING AND CLEAN UP CREW HAS BEEN EXTENDED. CALLER STATED NO WATERWAYS IMPACTED. NO OTHER CHANGES OR UPDATES. ORIGINAL REPORT READS: *** THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1443295*** UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: - REPORT UPDATED FROM "POTENTIAL" TO "ACTUAL" RELEASE - REPAIRS ARE EXPECTED TO EXCEED $150000 DAMAGE THRESHOLD - 10-11 CARS MAY HAVE TO BE DERAILED IN ORDER TO REPAIR DAMAGED RAILING FROM FIRE - NO PASSENGER OPS OR DELAYS ARE EXPECTED TO OCCUR AS A RESULT OF REPAIRS. - CALLER NOTED THE CAUSE OF THE FIRE WAS DUE TO A NATURAL GAS PIPE LINE LEAK. THE CAUSE OF THE LEAK IS UNKNOWN. - KINDER MORGAN HAS SHUT DOWN THE PIPELINE TO SECURE THE GAS LEAK. ORIGINAL REPORT BELOW: CALLER IS REPORTING A POTENTIAL RELEASE DUE TO A FIRE ON A FREIGHT TRAIN. CALLER STATED THERE ARE AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF HAZMAT CARS INVOLVED. NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES REPORTED. CALLER STATED THERE IS A FIRE BALL IN THE SKY DUE TO THIS INCIDENT. THIS INCIDENT IS NOT ON A PASSENGER TRAIN LINE. CALLER STATED IT IS UNKNOWN IF THERE ARE ANY DERAILED RAIL CARS. THE REPORTING PARTY HAD LIMITED INFORMATION. THE DAMAGE AMOUNT IS UNKNOWN.
